name: sitov-learning-recommendation-destinations-v1
rules: URL target is an identifier only; current learner server authorization and canonical level/parent resolution are mandatory.
Do not silently replace malformed, missing, revoked or foreign-level target with a generic target; use localized unavailable or retryable transport state.
Opening a recommendation never changes boxes, progress, streaks, checkpoints or commercial rights. Existing explicit learner actions remain authoritative.
Every actual German content subtree uses lang=de translate=no; surrounding controls use selected interface locale.
No visible recommendation links until the consumer and its secured action boundary are implemented and verified.

vocabulary.resolution: RLS exact learning_vocabulary_cards ID with embedded canonical active unit, actual level, parent and current item permission. Resolve stored lesson label, never treat unit UUID as label.
vocabulary.consumer: Open existing LessonCardsModal for the actual authorized lesson, visibly focus only the exact card without guessing labels; reject missing/foreign targets. Use existing explicit add/review controls. Preserve any pending global training round.
vocabulary.forbidden: No automatic addCardsToTrainer/initialization or replacement of saved direction-progress plan.

verbs.resolution: Find exact target in actual loadSitovVerbTrainer returned authorized catalog for level. Present must be supported.
verbs.consumer: Open existing verb box with exact target selected for viewing; show real stored progress and explicit add if absent. A targeted practice action filters existing authorized/selected due exercise choice to this ID and tense while keeping spacing/receipts intact.
verbs.forbidden: No automatic box write, invented due progress, broad sibling filtering by shared infinitive or silent level fallback.

learning_path.resolution: Exact actual get_learning_path node at requested level, available=true. Existing path source ID resolution remains strict unique.
learning_path.consumer: Open existing node choice or appropriate reviewed Special mode choice; never first-node substitution.

pronunciation.resolution: Exact current secured per-text pretest catalog at actual level, commercial access, current test status.
pronunciation.consumer: Existing S4 implemented exact pretest/passed-text flow; only current individual test passage unlocks target.

owners.S2: Recommendation resolver href change and path/Special target consumer; mandatory editorial topic mappings and source associations.
owners.S4: Only M explicitly assigned small vocabulary/verb route and existing component integrations; no new progress model.
owners.S1: Underlying exact commercial ports and any new navigation registration.
owners.M: Frozen shared contract and eventual verified integration.

args.p_node_ids: uuid[] unique1..200, explicit actual current map IDs only

sources.anchorSourceId: stored exact anchor source or null

rules: Fresh auth.uid; no caller/student identity or trusted rights input. Private SECURITY DEFINER emptysearchpath, public SECURITY INVOKER, narrow authenticated EXECUTE only; anon/PUBLIC/service deny; no broad table RLS change.

Only actual active canonical units+nodes, unique exact parent/level/source binding, currently available authorized get_learning_path nodes and commercial path_node/path_special item rights; Special same-parent active authorized anchor and existing publication/anchor-completion guards mandatory.

Return minimal content-source metadata only; never task answers/private sources/audio keys/accountprogress. No writes, no additional progress or pronunciation prerequisite. Missing/foreign/revoked/unavailable/ambiguous rows omitted; malformed input/auth/errors explicit stable envelopes.

Current source RLS blocker also affects ordinary path metadata. S2 replaces raw SELECT lookup using this port only after SQL/native proof. Public recommendations/pretestResult contracts remain unchanged.
